title: Revengeseekerz
desc_lfm_album: Revengeseekerz is the third studio album by the American musician Jane Remover. It was released by DeadAir Records on April 4, 2025. .
desc_lfm_artist:
Jane Remover is an American singer, songwriter, and producer from New Jersey based in Chicago, IL. They make electronic-infused pop, hip-hop, and rock music. They're also known for pioneering the genre dariacore under their side-project leroy  (a.k.a. c0ncernn). 

Jane Remover's interest in music production stems back as far as 2011, inspired by dubstep producers like Skrillex, Kill The Noise, and Virtual Riot. They would later go on to produce different styles of EDM in the mid-2010s, citing Porter Robinson as their biggest influence.
